task: Build a Jarvis module that cleans the Mac's disk space

nodes.do: Search ClickUp for 'clean-space'. If no task 'Jarvis build: clean-space' exists, create it in the list Jarvis Relay. Add the tag in-progress and comment the spec path. Write the task id in log.md.
nodes.undo: Comment on the ClickUp task that the build was rolled back and remove the tag in-progress.

nodes.do: Builder: the spec for the module clean-space is ready. It scans caches, old Downloads and the Trash, asks you, then moves files to the Trash. Do I build it?
Create modules/clean-space/ with module.toml (8 keys, required_gates = ["confirm-trash"]), CLAUDE.md and extensions/.gitkeep, as in the spec.
nodes.undo: Move modules/clean-space to the Trash with trash. Do not use rm.

nodes.do: Write modules/clean-space/skills/clean-space/SKILL.md: the scan commands, the DAG the session must write for each run (scan, show, gate confirm-trash, trash, verify), the Trash-only rule and the Finder undo that moves the items back.
Run uv run jarvis modules and confirm clean-space is listed. Check that the sample DAG in the new skill passes check_dag with the required gate confirm-trash.

Create a throwaway file under /tmp, move it with the trash command from the new skill, and confirm it is gone from /tmp and listed in the Trash by Finder. Then restore it with the undo command from the skill, confirm it is back in /tmp, and move it to the Trash again. Also run the scan once and confirm it prints caches, Downloads and Trash and changes nothing.
Run git add modules/clean-space and commit it on the current branch with the message 'feat(clean-space): disk clean module'. Do not push.
Comment the files built, the test results and the commit hash on the ClickUp task. Mark it complete and remove the tag in-progress.
